name: PlayerCameraRigSetup

menuItem: Toolkit/Camera/Set Up Third Person Camera On Selection
Toolkit/Camera/Set Up First Person Camera On Selection

src_typeComment: One-click rig setup, offered INSTEAD of shipping a .prefab.  A prefab would have to hard-bake a camera and its settings into a binary asset that can't be diffed or hand-edited, and it still wouldn't know which object in YOUR scene is the player. This does the one thing a prefab can't: it wires the rig to whatever you currently have selected. The component itself is already plug-and-play on any Camera, so this is convenience rather than a requirement.
